name: RCRCRC
when_to_use: Plan and prioritize regression testing after a change or bug fix.

letters.description: Recent — what new code or features were recently changed? Test around them.
Core — which essential functions must keep working? Prioritize these.
Risky — which features or code areas are inherently risky or historically buggy?
Configuration sensitive — what code depends on environment settings and could break?
Repaired — what was changed to fix defects, risking new issues?
Chronic — which areas break repeatedly? Give them more focus.

example: After a login fix: Recent=login change; Core=authn must still work; Risky=token refresh; Configuration=env-config timeouts; Repaired=the login fix; Chronic=the auth area that keeps regressing.
